name: Tennis Scorer
description: Keep score point by point: 15-30-40, deuce and advantage, tie-breaks, sets, who serves, and set or break point alerts.
prompt: A tennis and padel scorer: tap the player who wins each point and it handles 15, 30, 40, deuce, advantage or golden point, games, sets, tie-break at 6-6 with service changes, best of 1, 3 or 5 sets, break, set and match point alerts and undo.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Lleva el marcador punto a punto: 15-30-40, iguales y ventaja, tie-breaks, sets, quién saca y avisos de punto de set o de break.
